verification_policy: Only the final settled-tree executions establish current engineering results. Earlier focused runs remain diagnostics. The canonical Class-A artifact is promoted only after validating its complete selected population, exact identity and all passing outcomes. Browser proof uses the actual served application with isolated encrypted synthetic data and explicit scripted ports; it is not independent legal quality or production proof.

manual_walkthrough_findings.method: Actual in-app Chromium browser against the isolated synthetic served application; invitation fixture sign-in, intake, first brief, matter cover, changed instructions, attributed file, protective controls and research inspected. No real client data, legal source corpus or external model calls.
manual_walkthrough_findings.cover: Fixed actual persisted-field projection and shared deadline readback; absent or unreadable assessment cannot become an empty all-clear. Case dates and commission instruction dates are distinct.
manual_walkthrough_findings.historical_advice: Saved read-back now labels itself Recorded response and explicitly says it has not been reassessed against later file changes. The first 44-case browser run caught one genuine follow-up defect: shared record-command success refreshed only the board, retaining the unqualified live answer. The shared success path now restores the saved conversation using the existing intent-preserving owner. The unchanged browser witness changes instructions through the actual route and checks the same immutable receipt in workspace, History and reopen; Node controls require every successful record command to request that restore.
manual_walkthrough_findings.research: Not-assessed search no longer carries a Searched header. Primary unavailable/no-negative-legal-finding notice remains visible; exact operational reason is retained in an inspectable disclosure. Index build date is labelled index prepared, never legal current-to; unknown and zero indexed counts remain different. Four real served browser cases use missing or tiny synthetic SQLite indexes, not a fabricated live corpus.
manual_walkthrough_findings.attributed_file: Readable statement/revision headings retain the full stable record reference and all attribution/quality qualifications.
manual_walkthrough_findings.limitations: Manual observations and synthetic browser tests establish engineering behavior, not qualified legal quality, real provider approval, production readiness or full future-packet delivery.
